answer: Each key leases one meadow plot whose soil nonce is revealed only at assignment, then files a saffron harvest diary of intermediate growth states that only a mind which actually tended that plot through the epoch could reconstruct. A velvet slice of recently unlocked earnings sits slashable beside the lease. Colliding diaries (shared rounding, identical pests, the same skipped week) burn the velvet and the plot. A farm that shares one simulator collapses into matching traces, so an attacker pays for N separate full-season simulations plus N velvet buffers.
